title: Drive Motor Electrical Overload
shortDescription: Drive motor drawing too much current.
fullDescription:
Err1 indicates the drive motor is overloaded, often by debris jammed in the impeller or tracks. Power supply shuts down for protection.

Clear obstructions and inspect motor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect impeller
fixSteps.instruction: Open impeller cover and remove debris/hair.

title: Suction/Pump Motor Overload
fullDescription:
Err2 indicates the suction (pump) motor is drawing excessive current. Typically caused by clogged filters or debris in impeller.

Clean filters and inspect impeller.

title: Robot Operating Out of Water
fullDescription:
Err8 occurs when the robot cannot detect water flow, suggesting it has been started outside the pool, has lost prime, or the impeller has failed.

Never run dry; submerge and restart.

fixSteps.title: Submerge fully
fixSteps.instruction: Lower into pool and allow to fill.

title: Power Supply / Robot Communication Fault
fullDescription:
Err9 indicates the power supply cannot communicate with the robot. Usually a damaged floating cable or loose connector.

Inspect the swivel cable carefully.

fixSteps.title: Inspect cable
fixSteps.instruction: Look for cuts, kinks, exposed wire.

title: Power Supply Overheating
fullDescription: Err13 indicates the power supply unit is overheating, usually from direct sun or restricted airflow. Move to shade and allow to cool.
whenToCallPro: If recurs in shade, supply is failing.

title: Mains Voltage Out of Range
shortDescription: Input voltage too high or low.
fullDescription: Err15 indicates the AC input voltage is outside the specified range. Use a properly grounded outlet on a stable circuit.

fixSteps.title: Different outlet
fixSteps.instruction: Plug directly into a known-good GFCI outlet.

fixSteps.title: Replace supply
fixSteps.instruction: If error persists, supply is faulty.

faq.a: Only short, 14 AWG; avoid long runs.

title: Internal Module Communication Error
fullDescription: Err16 indicates a fault between internal control modules. Power cycle first; if persistent the supply or robot main board needs service.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Send to authorized dealer if recurring.

title: MyDolphin Wi-Fi Module Fault
fullDescription: Err17 indicates the wireless module on connected models cannot initialize. Robot still cleans manually; remote app may be unavailable.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Use MyDolphin app to push latest.

whenToCallPro: If module fails after firmware update.

title: Drive Belt or Track Slip
fullDescription: Err20 indicates the drive belt is worn, slipping, or detached. Robot may move erratically. Inspect tracks.

title: Power Supply Internal Failure
fullDescription: Err25 indicates the supply detected an internal hardware failure on startup. Replace the supply if recurring after a power cycle.
